invariants.rationale: Bucket numbers are typically non-negative indices into a map; negative values are unlikely to be valid.
The method immediately calls bucketInfoMap.get(bucketNumber), so bucketInfoMap is expected to be non-null.
The primary purpose of getBucketInfo is to retrieve a BucketInfo for a given bucketNumber; an invariant expressing that the key is present may help characterize expected calls.
bucketNumber is most likely an index less than the total number of buckets.
For any meaningful upsert partitioner state, there should be at least one bucket available.
